sources.title: IRB 360 FlexPicker
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Boston Dynamics Spot 巡檢平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付時間戳鏈、位置補償表與延遲辨識圖。；接受預測位置位於窗口內且三速度殘差皆低於 5 mm 的離線模型。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the timestamp chain, compensation table and latency-identification plot.; Accept the offline model only when predicted pickup remains in-window and residuals are under 5 mm at all three speeds.
related.difference: 建立巡檢路線能量預算，保留回程與資料重測餘裕。
related.differenceEn: Build an inspection-route energy budget including return and remeasurement reserve.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恆速輸送下，取像後位移 Δx=v(t處理+t移動)。；教學帶速 0.60 m/s，處理 0.12 s，手臂到位 0.18 s。；Δx=0.60×(0.12+0.18)=0.18 m。
定功率近似下 t=E可用/P，能量以 Wh、功率以 W 換算小時。；教學電量 100 Wh，保留 20 Wh，平均功率 120 W；任務需 35 min。；t=(100−20)/120×60=40 min；任務剩 5 min 餘裕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With constant conveyor speed, post-image displacement is Δx=v(processing time+travel time).; Teaching speed is 0.60 m/s, processing 0.12 s and robot arrival 0.18 s.; Δx=0.60×(0.12+0.18)=0.18 m.

Under constant power, t=usable energy/power; Wh divided by W gives hours.; Teaching energy is 100 Wh with 20 Wh reserved, average power 120 W and mission time 35 min.; t=(100−20)/120×60=40 min, leaving 5 min of mission margin.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: MAZAK INTEGREX 複合加工平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付時間戳鏈、位置補償表與延遲辨識圖。；接受預測位置位於窗口內且三速度殘差皆低於 5 mm 的離線模型。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the timestamp chain, compensation table and latency-identification plot.; Accept the offline model only when predicted pickup remains in-window and residuals are under 5 mm at all three speeds.
related.difference: 量化多次裝夾的基準傳遞不確定度，評估一次裝夾的價值。
related.differenceEn: Quantify datum-transfer uncertainty across setups and evaluate single-setup processing.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 恆速輸送下，取像後位移 Δx=v(t處理+t移動)。；教學帶速 0.60 m/s，處理 0.12 s，手臂到位 0.18 s。；Δx=0.60×(0.12+0.18)=0.18 m。
獨立裝夾隨機誤差以 RSS 合成；共用基準的相關誤差必須另外處理。；教學三次裝夾標準差 0.010、0.020、0.015 mm。；σ=sqrt(0.010²+0.020²+0.015²)=0.026926 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With constant conveyor speed, post-image displacement is Δx=v(processing time+travel time).; Teaching speed is 0.60 m/s, processing 0.12 s and robot arrival 0.18 s.; Δx=0.60×(0.12+0.18)=0.18 m.

Independent setup errors combine by RSS; correlated common-datum errors need separate treatment.; Teaching setup standard deviations are 0.010, 0.020 and 0.015 mm.; σ=sqrt(0.010²+0.020²+0.015²)=0.026926 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
